verification.notes: A registry-derived Ohio corporate history lists the entity's August 11, 1997 formation, Lori Frantzve as agent, Richard Erpenbeck as incorporator, and a January 2017 amendment changing AZ-TECH INTERNATIONAL to E3TEK GROUP. The source is secondary to the registry, so confidence is medium.
